title: Harun-Arun
overview: Harun Arun is a story of a child caught between the differences created by religion.Harun is a Pakistani boy who is lost in India; his name is mistaken for Arun-a Hindu name.He is loved by all but when his true identity is revealed,the same people push him away.This film that urges for the innocence; compassion of children in the affairs of the world, has won man
